choices.D: Randomly selecting 100 people from the list of all students at the school

question: To find out the average height of all students at a school, which of the following sampling methods is most reasonable?
solution: Of the options, randomly selecting 100 students from the full school list gives every student an equal chance of selection and avoids restricting the sample to a role, a team, or one grade. This makes D the most reasonable choice, although a particular random sample can still be unrepresentative by chance.
